newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: South Africa money shortage kicks up to 9.56 bln rand.
newsitem.headline: South Africa money shortage kicks up to 9.56 bln rand.

text.p: South Africa's money market shortage kicked back up at the end of last week, the Reserve Bank said on Monday.
The shortage stood at 9.556 billion rand on Saturday from 9.563 billion rand on Friday and 8.732 billion rand on Thursday.
But short-term money market rates eased slightly and dealers said they were expecting the downward trend in the shortage to resume despite the weekend blip.
Three-month NCD rates were lower at between 17.30 and 17.50 percent from 17.30 to 17.60, while the 90-day BA rate also fell slightly to between 16.65 and 16.85 percent from 16.65 to 16.90.
